question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'Something that is no longer in use'.
solution: The correct answer is: **Obsolete**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Obsolete"** refers to something that is no longer in use, or has become outdated due to advancements or changes over time. (अप्रचलित) • **Example:** The typewriter has become an obsolete device in the age of computers and laptops. • **"Outdated" **is a synonym of "Obsolete" and conveys the same meaning of something that has fallen out of use or favor. (अप्रचलित) • **Example:** Many traditional farming techniques are now considered obsolete due to modern machinery. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Obsolete**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Absolute **(पूर्ण): Refers to something that is complete, total, or not dependent on anything else. • **Example:** The king held absolute power over the kingdom. • **Medieval **(मध्यकालीन): Relates to the Middle Ages, a period in European history from the 5th to the late 15th century. • **Example:** The castle was built in the medieval period and has been well-preserved. • **Antique **(प्राचीन): Refers to something old and often valuable due to its age or rarity. • **Example:** She owns an antique vase that has been passed down through generations. 44:Ta32,
